messages:
emily-recruiter: Candidate Priya K. is ready for an offer. Role: Senior Infra Eng. Requesting comp-band exception +10,000 base due to relocation and counteroffer pressure. Need approvals + routing. Candidate wants start ~2026-04-15 but can be flexible to early May. Deadline: candidate needs response within 48h.
raj-peopleops: Thanks — can you paste the comp breakdown and relocation ask? Also include market comp data / peer comp if you have it. I can route once we have rationale.
lina-hiringmgr: +1 for hiring. Priya will unblock our cross-region infra work. I support a bump but prefer structuring as sign-on vs raised base if that helps approvals.
emily-recruiter: Hereʼs the quick breakdown:
```
Base: 165,000 (band max 160,000)
Requested bump: +10,000 base or +5,000 base + 5,000 sign-on
Relocation stipend: 8,000 one-time
Total first-year comp w/ sign-on: 178,000
```
Also adding market comp link: https://internal-comp/redwood/infra-2026.pdf
hiring-ops: I created the approval packet in Workday (https://workday/redwood/approvals/PA-9832). Added attachments. @raj-peopleops can you start the exception routing? Candidate window ends tomorrow EOD.
offer-bot: Offer workflow initiated (ID: OFF-9832). Current status: awaiting approvals from: people-ops, finance, executive (if escalated).
raj-peopleops: I can run this through comp committee today at 4pm. Two asks: 1) final preferred structure (base vs sign-on split) 2) confirmation that manager and budget owner sign off on hiring headcount.
lina-hiringmgr: Budget owner signoff confirmed — headcount in Q2 plan. I prefer +7k base + 3k sign-on (split), relocation unchanged. That keeps us closer to band while addressing retention.
tom-cfo: I can approve up to +7k on base within delegated authority. Anything above that needs exec signoff (Sasha). If we do a sign-on split it reduces recurring run-rate, so +3k sign-on is acceptable. Need the 3-year cost impact before final.
emily-recruiter: Candidate said 5/1 start is acceptable if sign-on is split into two payments (50% at start, 50% after 90 days). They prefer an earlier start but are open.
raj-peopleops: Proposal: +7k base + 3k sign-on (50/50 split), relocation 8k. I'll present this at 4pm committee. If committee approves, People Ops will push to finance for final sign-off and then to exec if needed.
sasha-ceo: @raj-peopleops please add a 1-line on retention risk and business impact for CEO review. Iʼll triage quickly if it lands on my queue.
raj-peopleops: Will do — adding a short note on cross-region infra unblock + projected sprint impact.
emily-recruiter: Candidate confirmed they accept the split plan in principle. Please expedite — they have another firm sending a revised offer tomorrow. :pray:
tom-cfo: If committee pushes for the extra +3k on base instead of sign-on I will need explicit CEO approval. Otherwise fine with your proposed split.
raj-peopleops: Noted. Committee scheduled. If we get committee thumbs-up, expected final approval path: people-ops -> finance (tom) -> HR exec (sasha) only if escalated. Will update by 19:30 PT.
hiring-ops: FYI once approved I can set up the offer with sign-on installments and add relocation logistics checklist to onboarding flow.
emily-recruiter: Amazing — thanks everyone. Iʼll hold candidate until 19:30 PT and update.
raj-peopleops: Update: comp committee approved +7k base + 3k sign-on split 50/50. Routing to finance now.
tom-cfo: Approved on finance side for the proposed structure. No CEO escalation needed.
emily-recruiter: Candidate verbally accepts with 5/1 start and sign-on split. Sending final offer docs now.
hiring-ops: Offer sent via Workday (OFF-9832). Onboarding ticket created: ONB-4473.
offer-bot: Offer OFF-9832 status -> sent to candidate; accepted (pending signed doc).
emily-recruiter: Signed docs received. Start date confirmed 2026-05-01. Closing loop, thank you all! :tada:
